G.R. No. 249759
Manila
FIRST DIVISION
G.R. No. 249759, April 22, 2026
JUANITO B. SOTO, PETITIONER,
vs.
CASSANDRA REYES-SOTO AND THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, RESPONDENTS.
D E C I S I O N
ROSARIO, J.:
To summarize, psychological incapacity consists of clear acts of dysfunctionality that show a lack of understanding and concomitant compliance with one's essential marital obligations due to psychic causes. It is not a medical illness that has to he medically or clinically identified; hence, expert opinion is not required.
There is likewise no rule requiring that an expert must personally interview both spouses for the testimony to be admissible or credible.
The partition of the co-owned properties is not a precondition, but is merely incidental to, and is a consequence of, the nullity of the marriage.
Soto and Reyes-Soto met and became friends in 1979 while they were college students at the University of the Philippines, Quezon City.
